stories.headline: EU Agrees Provisional Deal on Landmark AI Regulation
stories.summary: EU negotiators reached a tentative agreement on comprehensive AI rules. This landmark deal aims to set global standards for ethical AI development and deployment.

stories.headline: Fusion Reactor Achieves New Sustained Energy Record
stories.summary: Scientists announced a major breakthrough in fusion energy, sustaining a reaction for a record duration. This development moves humanity closer to clean, limitless power.

stories.headline: Asian Tech Giant Announces Global Restructuring, Job Cuts
stories.summary: A prominent Asian technology firm revealed a major global restructuring plan, including thousands of job cuts, citing market slowdowns and strategic refocusing efforts.

stories.headline: Aid Agencies Warn of Worsening Famine in East Africa
stories.summary: International aid organizations issued urgent warnings about a rapidly deteriorating famine crisis in parts of East Africa, exacerbated by conflict and climate change.

stories.headline: New Respiratory Virus Strain Detected in North America
stories.summary: Health authorities confirmed the emergence of a highly transmissible new strain of a common respiratory virus in North America, prompting increased public health advisories.
